chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: A week-long trip to Havana during the Miami engagement
summary: Because of ice-show renovations, he took Andino and Ubaldo Nieto to Havana while Mario saw his family.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Okay. All right, so at that time, I believe, Mario went to Havana, that's where he met Chano, did you go to Havana at all?

Yes, as a matter of fact, we went to Havana because the the new thing was the ice show, because they had an ice show, so they going to change all the floor and everything. So the owner said: 'Machito, I am going to pay you your salary, but you could take off five or six or seven days. I send you a telegram when the floor will be raised because we got to change all the things, you know, all that refrigeration or whatever, so we went to Havana. Took Andino with me and Ubaldo Nieto, the timbale player and bass player and Mario went to see his family, you know, his family live in Havana, so we was there about seven or eight days, and we come back and we finished our contract. We were there three months.
